name: Can I live in my home during a high-end remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a high-end remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a high-end remodel depends on the project's scope and the areas being renovated. For extensive projects involving major structural work, plumbing, or electrical system overhauls, or work across multiple critical living spaces, temporary relocation is often advisable for safety, comfort, and project efficiency. For smaller, contained projects, it might be possible to remain, provided adequate dust and noise mitigation measures are in place. We discuss these options thoroughly during the planning phase to determine the best approach for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during a high-end remodel depends on the project's scope; relocation is often advised for major work.
